title: lists max 7 or split
rule: Lists ≤7 items, or split by category. One idea per bullet; consistent grammar; numbered only for rank/order/steps. Lead-in must apply to every item (“all of” vs “one or more”).
pass_when: A list is ≤7 or split by category; numbered only for rank/order/steps; lead-in applies to every item.
fail_when: 8+ undifferentiated items; numbered list with no order; lead-in that does not apply to every item.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
